name: SolarWinds Service Desk
summary: SolarWinds Service Desk costs from $39 (Essentials), $99 (Advanced) or $124 (Premier) per technician a month, billed once a year. Essentials already includes incident management, a service catalog, SLA tracking and a CMDB, and end users are unlimited. The 30-day trial opens Premier features. The service says it is ISO 27001 certified and lets customers pick a US, EU or Australia data center.

facts.text: The CMDB administrator guide says the CMDB helps IT teams assess the risks and impacts of IT changes, and that impact and risk can be analyzed before a change is decided.
The CMDB administrator guide says the CMDB stores up-to-date information about all the technology components an organization uses.
The CMDB Visual Map shows dependent CIs as a tree, and the page says it is included in the Premier package.
SolarWinds says Service Desk is ISO 27001 certified and is GDPR compliant.
Servers are hosted by AWS in the United States, the European Union and Australia, and the customer chooses the region.
The vendor says it signs HIPAA Business Associate Agreements.
The 30-day trial gives full access to Premier features, and the trial account is disabled if the customer does not subscribe.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Starting price, billed annually. Incident management, knowledge base, service catalog, change management, CMDB, asset management and SLA tracking

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Starting price, billed annually. Adds custom forms, advanced automations, a virtual agent and API access

plans.name: Premier
plans.notes: Starting price, billed annually. Adds AI incident summaries, a visual CMDB and a sandbox

hiddenCosts: Asset pricing for Essentials is available on request.
The page does not name its pricing currency; the figures are shown with a dollar sign.
